intro: Professionals and everyday users convert carats (ct) to grams (g) when working across metric and metric standards in engineering specifications, international trade documentation, and technical measurements. One metric carat equals 0.2 grams, while 1 gram equals 5 carats. Whether you are verifying mass & weight specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

faqs.question: How many grams (g) are in 1 metric carat (ct)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.2 grams (g) in 1 metric carat (ct), which rounds to 0.2 g for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 gram equals 5 carats.

faqs.question: How do I convert carats to grams (ct to g)?
faqs.answer: To convert carats to grams, use the formula: g = ct × 0.2. For example, converting 10 ct gives 2 g.

faqs.question: What is 10 carats in grams?
faqs.answer: 10 carats (ct) equals exactly 2 grams (g) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
